legal_basis_or_note: Section 74 of the Indian Contract Act, 1872 provides that where a sum is named as payable on breach, the aggrieved party is entitled to reasonable compensation not exceeding that amount named. This reflects that Indian law does not require treating 'penalty' and 'liquidated damages' as separate legal categories the way some other jurisdictions historically have. Verify against current case law before relying on this in a legal claim.
